({{IPA|it|ˈinter}}), and commonly known as '''Inter Milan''' in English-speaking countries,{{Cite news |date=24 May 2012 |title=Inter Milan arrives in Jakarta to prepare for two friendlies |first=Niken |last=Prathivi |url=http://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2012/05/24/inter-milan-arrives-jakarta-prepare-two-friendlies.html |url-status=live |access-date=25 July 2013 |work=The Jakarta Post}} is an Italian professional [[Association football|football]] [[List of football clubs in Italy|club]] based in [[Milan]], Lombardy. Inter is the only team to have an unbroken presence in the top division of Italian football, currently [[Serie A]], since its debut in 1909, having never been relegated to [[Serie B]]. Since 1947, Inter has shared the [[San Siro]] stadium, the largest stadium in Italy,{{cite web |title=San Siro Stadium – "La Scala del Calcio" |url=https://sansirostadium.com/the-stadium/?lang=en |website=San Siro Stadium |access-date=6 February 2026 |archive-date=30 September 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250930203706/https://sansirostadium.com/the-stadium/?lang=en |url-status=live }} with [[AC Milan]], with whom it contests the long-standing [[Derby della Madonnina]], one of the most widely followed rivalries in world football.{{Cite web |date=12 May 2025 |title=Men's soccer rivalries to know: El Clásico, Manchester Derby |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/43360015/men-soccer-rivalries-know-el-clasico-manchester-derby |access-date=1 June 2025 |website=ESPN.com |language=en |archive-date=19 June 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250619152336/https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/43360015/men-soccer-rivalries-know-el-clasico-manchester-derby |url-status=live }} The club was founded on 9 March 1908 after a split within the Milan Foot-Ball and Cricket Club (now AC Milan), and won its first championship in 1910. Since its formation, the club has won 39 domestic trophies, including 21 [[Serie A|league]] titles, 10 [[Coppa Italia]], and 8 [[Supercoppa Italiana]]. From 2006 to 2010, the club won five successive league titles, equaling the all-time record at that time.{{Cite web |title=Italy – List of Champions |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesi/italchamp.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220711150721/https://www.rsssf.org/tablesi/italchamp.html |archive-date=11 July 2022 |access-date=2 February 2023 |website=[[RSSSF]]}} It has won the [[UEFA Champions League|European Cup/Champions League]] three times. Its latest win in 2010 completed an unprecedented Italian [[Treble (association football)|seasonal treble]], with Inter also winning the Serie A title and the Coppa Italia in the same year.{{cite news |date=22 May 2010 |title=Inter join exclusive treble club |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/0250-0c50f4b42c3a-0fbc1831ccbe-1000--inter-join-exclusive-treble-club/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121111175751/http://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/newsid=1490968.html |archive-date=11 November 2012 |access-date=9 August 2012 |website=[[UEFA]]}} The club has also won three [[UEFA Europa League|UEFA Cups]], two [[Intercontinental Cup (1960–2004)|Intercontinental Cups]], and one [[FIFA Club World Cup]]. Inter has the highest home game attendance in Italy{{cite web|date=18 October 2024|title=Average matchday attendance in Serie A in 2023/24, by club |url=https://www.statista.com/statistics/603298/soccer-average-attendances-at-serie-a-games-by-team-in-italy/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240911004016/https://www.statista.com/statistics/603298/soccer-average-attendances-at-serie-a-games-by-team-in-italy/| archive-date=11 September 2024 |access-date=29 April 2025 |website=Statista}} and the fourth-highest attendance in Europe.{{cite web|date=23 June 2024|title=Top 20 Highest European Clubs Attendances |url=https://stadiumdb.com/lists/top-20-highest-european-clubs-attendances/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250214205037/https://stadiumdb.com/lists/top-20-highest-european-clubs-attendances/ | archive-date=14 February 2025 |access-date=29 April 2025 |website=StadiumDB}} Since May 2024, the club has been owned by American [[asset management company]] [[Oaktree Capital Management]].{{cite news |title=Suning Holdings Group acquires majority stake of FC Internazionale Milano S.p.A. |url=http://www.inter.it/en/news/53171 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160609205104/http://www.inter.it/en/news/53171 |archive-date=9 June 2016 |access-date=6 June 2016 |publisher=Inter Milan}} [[File:San siro stadium.jpg|thumb|right|An aerial view of San Siro]]"}}
